notes: The FreeCAD ending (decision 0027): a desktop recording of FreeCAD 1.1 opening the take's STEP file (freecad.mjs, freecad_view.FCMacro), put in where it was recorded, while Blender renders the catalog image queued just before.
Times are seconds from the start of the clip (16 s). The macro holds the still model for 1.5 s, then turns it once around its axis.
No zoom: the solid fills the 3D view. A clip spec may add a zoom (start, factor, cx, cy, label), as hl-create-design's KiCad clips do.
label: FreeCAD 1.1 on the desktop (screen recording)

cues.subtitle: While Blender works, the STEP file opens in FreeCAD: real CAD geometry, not a picture.
The same solid CadQuery built from the validated numbers, ready for the mold maker.
FreeCAD is only a viewer here: the files were written after the designer's click.
